task_metadata.research_topic: activation function design for deep convolutional neural networks
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel activation function for deep convolutional neural networks that improves test accuracy across different architectures (ResNet, VGG) and datasets (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100).
notes: Required baselines from config.json are GELU, SiLU, and Mish.
Required tests from config.json are ResNet-20/CIFAR-10, VGG-16-BN/CIFAR-100, and hidden MobileNetV2/Fashion-MNIST.

tests.label: resnet20-cifar10
tests.notes: Links the ResNet architecture paper used for this benchmark family.

tests.label: vgg16bn-cifar100
tests.notes: Links the VGG architecture paper used by the benchmarked model variant.

tests.label: mobilenetv2-fmnist
tests.notes: Links the MobileNetV2 architecture and Fashion-MNIST dataset papers for the hidden evaluation setting.

baselines.name: gelu
baselines.notes: Baseline maps directly to the GELU activation.

baselines.notes: Baseline maps directly to the SiLU activation introduced in the cited paper.

baselines.notes: Baseline maps directly to the Mish activation.
